content: Android 11+ (API 30+) requires APK Signature Scheme v2 or higher; v1-only signed APKs fail to install/update with a generic 'app not installed' error. apksigner sign flags --v1-signing-enabled/--v2-signing-enabled/--v3-signing-enabled control which schemes are applied; must explicitly enable v2 (v1+v2 recommended for broad compatibility).
